newsitem.title: UK: NWE gas oil moves up on futures, premiums steady.
newsitem.headline: NWE gas oil moves up on futures, premiums steady.

text.p: NWE gas oil ticked up a touch on Friday, boosted higher by firmer IPE futures. Premiums were holding, but activity was slender.
May IPE gas oil was trading $1.00 a tonne stronger around 1200 GMT at $163.25 on the back of weather-related NYMEX heating oil strength.

Heating oil barge premiums were a touch firmer with offers at May IPE +$1 and +75 cents fob ARA and trades were concluded at May IPE 50 cents and 25 cents. Traders said business was fairly quiet, and few expected a significant hike in interest in the afternoon. First half May was offered 50 cents or so higher.
Diesel barges were heard offered between May IPE +$10-10.50 fob AR depending on refinery or storage grade. Buying interest was heard around May IPE +$9-9.50 fob.
FOD cargo premiums were holding around May IPE +$5 cif NWE while DIN was pegged up to a $1 weaker. Dealers said there was discussion for both grades, but trades had yet to be concluded.
